title: Kitamura Japan Used Camera & Lens Scraper
description: Scrape used cameras, lenses and electronics from shop.kitamura.jp via internal JSON API

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword, e.g. LEICA, FUJIFILM, シグマ, ニコン

categoryId.title: Category ID
categoryId.description: Optional category filter from the used camera category list

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Sort order: default, price ascending, price descending, or newest first

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to scrape (1-1000)

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy. Recommended when scraping at scale.
